name: Xtabay
title: Hungry Beauty
summary: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: A demon in the form of the beautiful mortal woman she once was, Xtabay represents the evil of those who maintain a veneer of virtue to mask a cruel heart. She lurks in woodlands, enticing passersby to lie with her before murdering them. Since the Shattering, she has expanded her hunt beyond Omeyocan, for Ryven is rich with potential victims.
archetype_description: Ignore 1% of enemy resistance for each piece of nightweave armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: If an enemy’s Turn Meter falls below 50%, place [Despair] on the target for 1 turn.
Also, remove the heroes [Shield] and [Barrier] then steal 1 random Buff.
